name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🐝 Forage range: each apiary's page shows how far its bees likely fly, with rings at 1, 2, 3 and 5 miles on a street map or satellite view (needs signal).
Set an apiary's spot without going there: find its street address, or tap the spot on a map. It stays on your own devices.
Treatments have an optional lot number (printed on the package), to trace a treatment back if there are ever problems. Typed, said, or in a schedule.
Erase everything now saves a backup of your hives first, and ↩️ Put my old records back brings them right back.
HiveMind has a new name: Bee Yard Wingman. Same app, same links, and all your hives and records stay just as they were.
"I didn't look", "didn't check" or "not sure" (eggs, the queen, queen cells) is no longer saved as a No. It's left blank, said or typed.
Hands-free: "a couple", "two" or "several" answers a yes-or-no question as yes.
On/off switches work with screen readers and keyboards too.

New bottom board: Screened with oil pan. The hive's page gets an 🛢️ Oil pan section: log when the oil went in or was changed, and each check (beetles caught, oil OK or needs changing). A reminder to check it comes up every 14 days (change the days per hive).
In an inspection of an oil-pan hive: tap Oil pan checked or Oil changed, and the beetles in it. Or say "checked the oil pan, about twenty beetles" or "changed the oil".
Honey by apiary: the Harvest tab shows each apiary's honey for a year or every year. Tap an apiary to see its hives, then a hive to open it. A hive's honey tab shows its total and each year.
Treatments keep how much went in: grams, mL, strips and more, for the whole hive or per brood box (Bee Yard Wingman works out the hive's total). A dribble also keeps the seams of bees.
Say or write "vaporized 2 grams of oxalic" or "dribbled 30 mL on 6 seams" and the method and amount fill in. Dribble and trickle are one choice now.
Peppermint is on the treatment list, for small hive beetles.
Treatment schedules take an amount too, and each hive's total is saved with it.
New things to record: bees added to a colony (package, nuc, frames, and from which hive), pesticide harm, frames of comb replaced, and at a dead-out whether the queen was found and the honey robbed.
The Bee Buddy Voice says more: amounts, seams, peppermint, and every "seen or done" item in the read-back (bearding, mouse guard on, swarmed and more). "Ounces" sounds right now.
